INTERPRETATION

How to read these results

Jev receives the original text, the same labeled examples and the source model’s cached class proposal. It may keep or change that proposal. The reviewer receives a saved class label without a rationale. Jev makes a separate decision after the source LLM; this experiment does not change the source LLM’s decoder.

Compare the pipeline with Jev alone to check whether the source LLM contributes to the final decision.
